reply:
Menurut saya, laporan konsumsi BBM mingguan sebaiknya memuat:

1. Ringkasan minggu ini
   Total BBM terpakai (liter), total biaya, dan perubahan dibanding minggu sebelumnya.

2. Rincian per kendaraan atau alat
   Identitas unit, jumlah BBM, jarak tempuh atau jam operasi, serta konsumsi rata-rata dalam km/liter atau liter/jam.

3. Catatan pengisian
   Tanggal, unit, volume, harga per liter, total biaya, dan lokasi pengisian. Bisa dilengkapi nomor bukti transaksi.

4. Penyimpangan yang perlu diperiksa
   Misalnya konsumsi naik tajam, pengisian tidak wajar, atau data odometer yang tidak lengkap. Ini tanda untuk ditinjau, bukan otomatis bukti penyalahgunaan.

5. Kesimpulan dan tindak lanjut
   Penyebab perubahan yang sudah diketahui dan rekomendasi, seperti pemeriksaan kendaraan atau perbaikan pencatatan.

Yang penting, bedakan BBM yang dibeli dengan yang benar-benar dikonsumsi. Kalau hanya tersedia nota pengisian, sebaiknya disebut laporan pengisian dan biaya BBM; konsumsi aktual memerlukan metode pengukuran yang konsisten.

Format awal yang praktis: satu halaman ringkasan, lalu tabel rincian sebagai lampiran.

Panduan onboarding pengemudi baru — versi umum

Panduan ini perlu disesuaikan dengan jenis armada, lokasi operasi, dan SOP perusahaan sebelum ditetapkan sebagai pedoman resmi.

1. Administrasi dan pengenalan
   - Verifikasi identitas, SIM yang sesuai kendaraan, dan dokumen lain sesuai persyaratan setempat.
   - Kenalkan pengemudi kepada atasan, dispatcher, petugas armada, dan kontak darurat.
   - Jelaskan penugasan, rute, jadwal, prosedur istirahat, serta pelaporan keterlambatan dan ketidaksiapan bekerja.

2. Pengenalan kendaraan
   - Dampingi pengemudi mengenali dimensi kendaraan, titik buta, kapasitas muatan, kontrol, dan perlengkapan keselamatan.
   - Jelaskan penggunaan kartu BBM, GPS, serta dokumen dan kunci kendaraan.
   - Lakukan latihan manuver di area aman sebelum perjalanan operasional.

3. Pemeriksaan sebelum berangkat
   - Periksa ban, lampu, rem, kemudi, kaca, sabuk keselamatan, cairan, dan indikasi kebocoran.
   - Pastikan muatan terikat dan perlengkapan keselamatan tersedia.
   - Catat odometer serta kerusakan awal. Jangan operasikan kendaraan dengan gangguan yang membahayakan; laporkan kepada petugas armada.

4. Keselamatan selama perjalanan
   - Gunakan sabuk keselamatan, patuhi batas kecepatan dan rambu, serta jaga jarak aman.
   - Jangan menggunakan ponsel saat mengemudi atau berkendara dalam kondisi mengantuk maupun terpengaruh zat yang mengganggu kemampuan mengemudi.
   - Berhenti di lokasi aman bila lelah atau kondisi perjalanan tidak aman; beri tahu dispatcher.
   - Ikuti prosedur perusahaan untuk parkir, mundur, bongkar muat, dan pengamanan kendaraan.

5. Pencatatan perjalanan dan BBM
   - Catat tanggal, pengemudi, unit, tujuan, serta odometer awal–akhir.
   - Setiap pengisian: catat liter, jenis BBM, biaya, odometer, dan simpan bukti transaksi.
   - Bedakan jumlah pengisian dari konsumsi aktual. Perhitungan liter per 100 km harus memakai data konsumsi dan jarak pada periode pengukuran yang sesuai.

6. Kerusakan, kecelakaan, dan keadaan darurat
   - Berhenti dan amankan diri serta lokasi sejauh aman dilakukan.
   - Hubungi layanan darurat setempat jika diperlukan, lalu kontak perusahaan.
   - Jangan memaksakan kendaraan yang tidak aman atau melakukan perbaikan di luar kompetensi.
   - Catat waktu, lokasi, kronologi, dan dokumentasi bila aman; ikuti prosedur pelaporan insiden.

7. Penutupan tugas
   - Parkir dan kunci kendaraan sesuai prosedur.
   - Serahkan catatan perjalanan, bukti pengisian, serta laporan kerusakan atau kejadian.
   - Lakukan serah terima kunci dan kondisi kendaraan kepada petugas terkait.

8. Penilaian sebelum bertugas mandiri
   - Pengemudi mendemonstrasikan pemeriksaan kendaraan, manuver aman, pencatatan perjalanan/BBM, dan respons darurat.
   - Pendamping mencatat hasil, kebutuhan latihan tambahan, serta rekomendasi kesiapan.
   - Penugasan mandiri dilakukan setelah persetujuan penanggung jawab.

Data yang perlu dilengkapi: jenis kendaraan, wilayah operasi, kontak darurat, SOP perusahaan, serta nama pihak yang berwenang menyetujui kesiapan pengemudi.

reply:
Recorded as two independent responsibilities. The checklist is below; the cost report is waiting for your records. No inspection schedule has been created.

1. Tyre inspection checklist

Vehicle ID: __________   Odometer: __________
Date/time: __________   Inspector: __________

Mark each item Pass / Fail / Not applicable. Record measurements separately for each wheel position.

Safe preparation
[ ] Park on firm, level ground, apply the parking brake, and secure the vehicle against movement.
[ ] Inspect away from traffic. Do not crawl beneath an unsupported vehicle.
[ ] Have a suitable pressure gauge and tread-depth gauge available.

Tyre specification and pressure
[ ] Check tyre size, load rating and fitment against vehicle manufacturer requirements.
[ ] Measure cold pressure at every wheel position, including inner tyres on dual-wheel installations.
[ ] Record actual and specified pressure; use the vehicle/load specification, not the sidewall maximum as the target.
[ ] Inspect valves and caps for damage or signs of leakage.

Tread and condition
[ ] Measure and record tread depth across the tyre and at several points around it.
[ ] Compare readings with applicable legal limits and company replacement criteria.
[ ] Check for uneven wear, flat spots, exposed cords and tread separation.
[ ] Inspect tread and accessible sidewalls for cuts, cracks, bulges and embedded objects. Do not pull out embedded objects during the check.
[ ] For dual tyres, check spacing, contact and trapped debris.

Wheels and spare
[ ] Inspect rims for cracks, deformation or other visible damage.
[ ] Check for missing or visibly loose wheel fasteners and displaced indicators where fitted. Torque checks must follow the approved procedure.
[ ] Check the spare tyre’s condition, pressure and secure mounting, where fitted.

Defects and release
[ ] Record each defect, wheel position, measurement and photograph where useful.
[ ] Do not dispatch with bulges, exposed cords, separation, significant pressure loss, damaged wheels, loose/missing fasteners or another safety-critical defect. Refer to qualified maintenance personnel.
[ ] Record corrective action and reinspection before release.

Inspection record — repeat per tyre:
Wheel position: __________
Pressure, actual / specified: __________
Tread depth readings: __________
Defect / action: __________

Outcome: Fit for service / Hold for repair
Inspector: __________   Release authorised by: __________

Vehicle-specific pressure values and applicable tread limits must be confirmed before use.

2. Monthly maintenance cost report

Please send:
- Reporting month and year.
- Vehicles included: one unit, selected units or the whole fleet.
- Currency.
- Maintenance invoices or expense records, including dates, vehicle IDs, work descriptions, parts, labour, tax, discounts and totals.
- Whether the report should track costs incurred during the month or payments made during the month.

The report will include total costs, breakdowns by vehicle and maintenance category, transaction details, and missing-data notes. Budget comparisons and cost per kilometre can be included if you provide budgets and distance records.

No costs or totals have been assumed.

reply:
A weekly report would give faster visibility into repair spending and unusual costs, but require more frequent reconciliation.

Main tradeoffs:

- Earlier action: spot cost spikes and recurring repairs sooner.
- More administration: collect, check and reconcile records every week.
- More volatility: one major repair can dominate a week, making comparisons misleading.
- Invoice timing: late invoices may leave weekly totals incomplete or require revisions.
- Budget alignment: monthly reporting usually fits accounting and budget reviews better; weekly reporting helps operational decisions.

A practical option is a brief weekly snapshot alongside the formal monthly report, with provisional figures clearly labelled.

The current requirement remains monthly; no weekly report or schedule has been added.
